City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  January 14, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:58 a.m.

  Members Present: Kenneth R. Campos, City Attorney
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Maria E. Heaney, Finance Manager

  Staff Present:  Sabrina Barnes, Director of Parks, Recreation & Library Services
  Toya Ferguson, General Services Supervisor
  Micah Herd, Police Grants Coordinator

1. The minutes of December 10, 2018, meeting was approved as recorded.
2. Enterprise Ren-A-Car – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $2,409.00. Motion carried unanimously.
3. Dewey Pest Control – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $3,900.00. Motion was carried unanimously.

4. Poly-Mode – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended settlement
  payment of $2,600. Motion was carried unanimously.

5. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:58 a.m.

Adjournment
